summary: Tested the new Go Perks 'Business area + locked portal until profile complete' changes. Added /app/backend/tests/test_business_profile.py (10 new tests). Full regression (existing + new) = 56 passed, 1 skipped (gate test that auto-skips once seed profile is complete). Playwright smoke confirmed: /register has auth-business-link and no member/business role toggle; /login has partner link; /business/register & /business/login use biz-navbar with PARTNERS badge and no Google button; member logging in on /business/login is shown auth-wrong-area; business portal /business shows business-profile-link card after profile completed; /business/profile has business-profile-form and profile-logo-input; nav-for-businesses present on main navbar; /business/sticker redirects to /business/login?next=... when logged out; /business/forgot-password renders with back link to /business/login; mobile 390px partner navbar fits (logo + PARTNERS badge + Log in).

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on mount (carry-over from iteration 1).
Still occasional console warning 'ensure container has non-static position' from a scroll library on /business.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1413 lines - still growing, worth splitting (auth/deals/admin/business/payments/cron) for maintainability.

require_partner uses 403 for both 'not approved' and 'profile incomplete' - frontend relies on error text to distinguish. Consider a machine-readable code field in the error body so UI isn't text-matching.
upload_logo: files collection uses is_deleted soft-delete but the old blobs in Emergent object storage are not deleted - small cost leak over time; acceptable for MVP.
GET /api/files/{path} only serves kind='logo'; if more file kinds are added later, remove the hard filter or make it dynamic.
ProfileIn: 'about' min_length=10 - server returns 422 (pydantic) rather than a friendly 400; frontend should surface the validation detail cleanly.
test_credentials: Used seed creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Created a few TEST_ pending business users; did NOT touch jaketcamileri@gmail.com.
seed_data_creation: Seed business@tinysvouchers.com.au profile was filled in via PUT /api/business/profile with 'Tiny''s Test Cafe' address 1 Test Lane, Melbourne, hours Mon-Fri 8-4, about 'A lovely test cafe for regression runs.', instagram tinytest, website https://testcafe.example.com, plus a 2x2 PNG logo uploaded. One TEST_ approved deal submitted under this business for partner-card verification on /api/deals/{id}. Main agent said this can be reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_business_profile.py exercises the profile gate (require_partner returns 403 with 'profile' text when incomplete), PUT /business/profile normalises website/instagram, logo upload accepts PNG/JPG/WebP <3MB and serves via /api/files/{path}, pending business cannot PUT profile (403), and partner block appears on /api/deals/{id} once owner profile is filled. If the seed business profile is reset to incomplete again, the TestProfileGate.test_partner_endpoints_blocked_when_incomplete test will run instead of being skipped.
rca of the issue: No issues found. One pre-existing minor: /business/deals POST requires 'discount_label' field — updated test accordingly.
